en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Zureys Al Kunasy who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From where did the adultery enter upon the people?’
I said, ‘I don’t know, may I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From the direction of our<sup>asws</sup> Khums (fifth) of the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household, except for our<sup>asws</sup> Shias who are the clean ones, for it is Permissible (Khums so that) for them for their births (to be also clean)’.
